13:6.text: They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good,
while there has already occurred before them similar punishments
. And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.

13:7.text: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and for every people is a guide.

13:8.text: Allāh knows what every female carries
And everything with Him is by due measure.

13:9.text: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

13:10.text: speech or publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous

13:11.text: before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allāh.
Indeed, Allāh will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allāh intends for a people ill,
there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.

13:12.text: It is He who shows you lightning,
fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds.

13:13.text: with praise of Him - and the angels
from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allāh; and He is severe in assault.
